consent.title: Welcome to the Wahl Agent
consent.subtitle: Your personal companion for forming political opinions
consent.contribution: By taking part in this research study, you're doing your bit for a healthy democracy in Germany. Thank you!
consent.purpose: Politics is a complex and often emotional subject. That's exactly why it matters to form a well-founded opinion. In the following conversation, the Wahl Agent will help you describe your concerns and put your ideal solution into words, so you can find the party that suits you best.
consent.privacyResearchOnly: Your information is used solely for scientific research
consent.privacyConfidential: The conversation is confidential and won't be passed on to third parties
consent.notice: By clicking "I agree", you confirm that you consent to taking part in this research study.
